purpose: Preserve the distinction between configured production money-movement authority and an actually performed economic transaction.

classification.EXECUTION_OBSERVED: at least one independently recorded execution receipt exists
classification.HOLD: production capability is unavailable or a hard gate prevents authorization

hard_rules: Never infer a performed transaction from money_movement_authorized=true.
Never infer entitlement, rights, payout truth, settlement truth, or provider success as CrownThrive economic authority.
Agent Wallet unattended value remains zero until separately certified.
Private wallet material must never appear in source control, logs, docs, DAIL payloads, MCP responses, or public APIs.
